groups.contract: Bounded collider projection and shell material validation
groups.evidence: Collider1–111/165–171 and shell lib1–56 read. push_out has six bounded iterations; keep_clear returns for fewer than2 points, uses fixed nonzero quarter samples, accumulates per-point max-length pushes, and intentionally skips root. NoCollider deliberately returns positive infinity distance so no correction occurs. Shell material validates finite nonnegative values with strictly positive thickness; particle_radius multiplies by.5.
qualifications: Finite positive smallest thickness may halve to0: representability/radius semantics question, not automatically forbidden material or an ordinary defect without Shell recipient proof.

push_out/keep_clear are bounded approximation kernels, not proof universal clearance for arbitrary Collider implementation; actual valid distance/gradient contract and physical scales required. Legal NoCollider infinity sentinel must remain.
